entity_card.declared_payload_fields_reason: PROPOSED, task 621 -- ratified on merge. The fields a re-gate, a cross-store subtraction and a per-country census all need, and the fields the 1024 rebuild dropped with no check able to see it go. MEASURED on aw_e8 2026-09-19 over all 337,702 source_type=entity_card points: legal_form 0, legal_form_code 0, resolve_confidence 0, canton 0, names 0 -- against the July generation (aw_v4_sat), which carried legal_form non-null on 5,696 of the 6,172 rows of one batch and resolve_confidence on all 6,172. ADR-041 SS5 ratified 'store the surviving score in each card payload (resolve_confidence) so we can also re-gate live if needed': unmet for 100% of the live population, so a threshold change today means re-resolving 194,255 entities. register_id + register_scheme are already ratified in specs/entity-cards-phase2-companies.md and are named here so the declaration has one home. Presence is not enough -- the check refuses a field that is present and empty, because legal_form_code survived as a key on all 6,172 July rows with 0 non-null values. Enforced by pipeline/register_first_cards.assert_payload_contract; the producer writes legal_form only once this declaration lands (AW_CARD_LEGAL_FORM). PROPOSED ADDITION, task 623 (2026-09-20) -- ratified on the same merge: `register_role`, enum {locator, enrichment, self-declared-verified}, the field that says which of the two register uses POLICY SS4.9.4 permitted for this card. `locator`: the register bulk product was consulted only internally to find and verify a site (ADR-041 SS4); nothing register-derived is published -- BE's viable reading (specs/register-first-cards-all-countries.md SS4.6). `enrichment`: the register's licence additionally permits publishing register-sourced fields -- the current CH/UK/FR/CA shape. `self-declared-verified`: no register was consulted at all; identity comes from a statutory on-page disclosure duty (e.g. a German Impressum) corroborated by an independent per-check service (VIES) rather than by the register itself -- DE's PENDING mode-A-prime reading (SS4.7a). Mandatory on every entity_card regardless of country from ratification forward.
entity_card.declared_payload_fields_applies_to: cards emitted by pipeline/register_first_cards.py from this ratification forward. NOT retroactive: the 337,702 live cards do not acquire the fields by this merge, and backfilling them is a separate, measured lane. `register_role` gates the OTHER declared fields at write time: the producer refuses register_id/register_scheme/legal_form/legal_form_code and the identity_fields_each register_officers facet on any card whose country's register_role is `locator` or `self-declared-verified` -- those populate only under `enrichment`.

SA', 'AM ET SA', 'NO FUR', 'And and and'), where demanding the tokens back measures the filter and not the surface. MEASURED at 26 of 339,307 = 0.000077. It is a COUNT, not a waiver: identity.sparse itself stays at 0.
entity_card.rule: REGISTER-FIRST, THEN A BOUNDED WEBSITE DESCRIPTION (ADR-060a, Tim 2026-09-06): a card's dense surface is the commercial-register composition -- `Name -- <register purpose>. Registered signatories/officers (commercial register): <officers>.` -- and the entity's own website contributes nothing to identity or officers. Officers trace to the register evidence unit (ADR-094 6a), never to website prose. A website-derived dense surface (`dense_class: website_content`) is a REFUSAL while any register-, description- or synth-class surface exists. The sparse channel is the register hook bag (name + UID + people tokens), ADR-060 (b): hooks, never sentences. The ruled composition is `<Name> -- <register purpose>. Registered signatories/officers (commercial register): <officers>. <bounded website description>` -- Tim's own words allow "at most a bounded description sentence after the register text", and both halves of his ruling hold BECAUSE OF THE ORDER: the name, the purpose and every officer are the head and come only from the register evidence unit; the website supplies a trailing description, bounded by entity_card_website.normalized_content_tokens (the ratified ADR-060 budget), and can never displace, truncate or contribute a name. A website-FIRST surface (`dense_class: website_content`) stays a refusal. Priced on one variable over the 13 card golds: register-only 0 h@1 / 2 h@10, this composition 6 / 7, pre-528a website-only 7 / 10 -- and all six wins are intent-paraphrase queries, not the one site-verbatim tautology (tasks/528a-artifacts/hybrid-price.json). PROPOSED as ADR-060a; see tasks/528a-surface-delta.md §6.8 and tasks/528a2-ruled-composition.md.

site_name_identity.why: ADR-061 bug #1, recurring. A family whose pages are named by their SITE -- a foundation, a commune, a small owned org -- is queried by that name, and trafilatura's cleaned title drops it as if it were an outlet suffix. When declared, every row of the family must carry `aw_common.site_entity_label(url)` in the named channels; the checker and the composer read the SAME function, so the guard can never pass a row the composer could not build.
